GET /A_PlannedOrder: Reads information on the header data of planned orders.
POST /A_PlannedOrder: Creates a new planned order.
GET /A_PlannedOrder('{PlannedOrder}'): Reads information on the header data of a single planned order.
PATCH /A_PlannedOrder('{PlannedOrder}'): Updates header data of a planned order.
DELETE /A_PlannedOrder('{PlannedOrder}'): Deletes a single planned order.
GET /A_PlannedOrder('{PlannedOrder}')/to_PlannedOrderCapacity: Reads the header data of a planned order including the capacity data.
GET /A_PlannedOrder('{PlannedOrder}')/to_PlannedOrderComponent: Reads the header data of a planned order including the components.
POST /A_PlannedOrder('{PlannedOrder}')/to_PlannedOrderComponent: Creates new components for a planned order.
GET /A_PlannedOrderCapacity: Reads the capacity data of planned orders.

GET /A_PlannedOrderCapacity(CapacityRequirement='{CapacityRequirement}',CapacityRequirementItem='{CapacityRequirementItem}',CapacityRqmtItemCapacity='{CapacityRqmtItemCapacity}'): Reads the capacity data for a single item.
GET /A_PlannedOrderComponent: Reads the data of planned order components.
POST /A_PlannedOrderComponent: Creates a new component for a planned order.
GET /A_PlannedOrderComponent(Reservation='{Reservation}',ReservationItem='{ReservationItem}'): Reads the data of a single planned order component.
PATCH /A_PlannedOrderComponent(Reservation='{Reservation}',ReservationItem='{ReservationItem}'): Updates the data of a single planned order component.
DELETE /A_PlannedOrderComponent(Reservation='{Reservation}',ReservationItem='{ReservationItem}'): Deletes the data of a single planned order component.
POST /PlannedOrderSchedule: Performs detailed scheduling of a planned order
POST /SchedulePlannedOrderOperation: Schedules order operations
